item.title: NY DMV offices to close Friday for system upgrade
item.description: All New York DMV offices will close at 2 p.m. Friday, Feb. 13, for a systemwide upgrade.

item.title: Child rescued from pond in Queens
item.description: A child was rescued from a pond in the Springfield Gardens section of Queens, the FDNY said.

item.title: Up to 3 inches of snow possible Sunday night in New York City, Long Island, northeast New Jersey
item.description: The National Weather Service says light accumulating snow is possible across the New York City metro area Sunday night into Monday morning.

item.title: Nancy Guthrie: Gloves found with DNA appears to match suspect's gloves in surveillance

item.title: New NJ Transit schedule begins
item.description: Starting today, Sunday, Feb. 15, and running through March 15, all NJ Transit rail lines except the Atlantic City Rail Line will operate on modified schedules.

item.title: Presidents' Day is today: Here's what's open and closed
item.description: Presidents' Day falls on the third Monday in February each year. In 2026, it lands on Feb. 16.

item.title: New York drivers will face more points on their license as new penalties take effect
item.description: Under the new rules, drivers can have their licenses suspended after accumulating 10 points over a 24-month period.

item.title: WATCH: Retired police lieutenant discusses gloves, possible motive in Nancy Guthrie case
item.description: Retired police Lt. Randy Sutton said the glove resembles one seen on surveillance video, but cautioned against assuming it belongs to the suspect.

item.title: Hochul and Mamdani announce $1.5B in state budget relief
item.description: Hochul has increased state support for New York City including the latest commitment to expand universal child care in the city.
